LEARNING OBJECTIVE

FUN-6.D
For integrands 
requiring substitution 
or rearrangements into 
equivalent forms:

(a) Determine indefinite 

integrals.

(b) Evaluate definite 

integrals.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

FUN-6.D.3 
Techniques for finding antiderivatives include 
rearrangements into equivalent forms, such as 
long division and completing the square.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

FUN-6
Recognizing opportunities to apply knowledge of geometry and mathematical rules 
can simplify integration.
